subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 04, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - October 4, 2026**

**Exciting News: Zig 0.17 Released!**

The AcreetionOS community is abuzz with the recent release of Zig 0.17! This major update brings significant improvements to the language, including better performance, improved error handling, and enhanced tooling. As a community-driven Linux distribution, we're always on the lookout for innovative tools to enhance our users' experience. Zig 0.17 is a great addition to our ecosystem, and we're excited to see how developers will utilize its features.

**Community News**

* The AcreetionOS community has been actively contributing to various open-source projects, including the Linux Test Project suite. Our community members have been working tirelessly to ensure that our distribution remains stable and secure.
* We're proud to announce that our Discord server has seen a significant increase in activity, with more users joining the conversation and participating in discussions. If you're not already a member, join us today and be a part of the AcreetionOS community!

**Practical Tip: Customizing Your AcreetionOS Experience**

Did you know that you can customize your AcreetionOS experience to suit your needs? With our modular design, you can easily swap out components and add new ones to create a tailored experience. For example, you can replace the default Cinnamon desktop with a different desktop environment or add custom scripts to automate tasks. To get started, check out our wiki guides and explore the many possibilities available to you.

That's all for this week's newsletter. Stay tuned for more updates, and don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or feedback. Happy hacking!

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
